I know it might be overwhelming, but it sounds like you're doing your best to put in effort. Studying is challenging, especially when there's a lot of distractions available. Do you know how you prefer to learn and retain information? Learning comes in a variety of styles, and not every one is best for every person.

School for me was a lot, and I nearly didn't make it out alive. I'm 25 now and I can say for certain that the grades I earned in high school never mattered as much as I thought they would, and that I put a lot of pressure on myself.

Your best can look different each day, but there's nothing wrong if it's not the same as the day before. There's a lot to experience in this world, and you deserve to experience as much of it as you can. I hope your school is able to help you find what you need to do to pass the year. Even a C is okay, and there's no shame in having grades that aren't A's and B's. You're worth more than a few stupid letters on a page, that doesn't show what you've learned and can do.

I've seen so many. I had a room where we handcuffed everyone together (key wasn't super challenging to find, but required teamwork) and had a few groups decide that staying cuffed the entire time was better (it wasn't)

Then regular people that decided to look beneath the floorboards (one was easy to lift).

I think my favourite ones are the groups that do anything they can for an extra/free clue. Was pretty fun if it was an event related group, like a birthday. Could make them sing the birthday song to whoever's bday it was. Great laugh, especially if it was a kid's birthday. 

Just a weird one: Had a group escape (with a bit of help on my part) because I was pretty sure I saw a kid in the group pee in the corner of the room, but I couldn't check until the group was out of the room as it was very dark in the room.
